shonen-delinquent.en: Subject: A 17-year-old delinquent boy seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, his whole head and both hands inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. Bleached hair swept back, shown as pale tone, a long open school jacket, a small bandage across the bridge of his nose. Both hands in his pockets, chin raised, looking down at someone with one corner of his mouth lifted in a bold smirk. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: an old shopping arcade: closed shop shutters as flat grey panels, the arcade roof as ruled lines, signboards as blank white rectangles.
shonen-delinquent.ja: 題材: 17歳くらいの不良の少年の腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手が画面に収まる。後ろになでつけた脱色した髪（淡いトーン）、前を開けた丈の長い学生服、鼻すじに小さなばんそうこう。両手をポケットに入れ、あごを上げて相手を見下ろし、口の端を上げて不敵に笑う。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 古い商店街のアーケード。閉まったシャッターは平らな灰色の板、屋根は定規の線、看板は文字のない白い四角。

shonen-fantasy.en: Subject: A 16-year-old boy apprentice mage seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, his whole head, both hands and the whole magic circle inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. Short messy black hair, a hooded traveling cloak over a simple tunic with a leather belt. He thrusts one open hand forward; a round magic circle hangs in the air in front of his palm, drawn as thin white lines; his other hand holds a plain wooden staff. A calm, focused look straight ahead. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: a grassy hill: a walled town and distant mountains as flat grey silhouettes, grass as flat tone, not drawn blade by blade.
shonen-fantasy.ja: 題材: 16歳くらいの少年の魔法使い見習いの腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手と魔法陣全体が画面に収まる。無造作な短い黒髪、簡素な上着に革のベルト、フード付きの旅のマント。片手を前に突き出し、手のひらの前に円い魔法陣が白い細い線で浮かぶ。もう片方の手に飾りのない木の杖。落ち着いて集中した目で正面を見据える。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 草原の丘。城壁のある町と遠くの山は平らな灰色の影、草は平らなトーンで1本ずつ描かない。

shonen-linecarved.en: Subject: A large man of about 35 seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, his whole head and both hands inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. Close-cropped black hair, a heavy work shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a thick neck, broad shoulders and thick arms. He clenches one fist in front of his chest and gazes quietly into the distance with knitted brows, mouth closed. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: a harbour pier at dusk: distant ships and warehouses as simple shapes, the sky left white.
shonen-linecarved.ja: 題材: 35歳くらいの大柄な男の腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手が画面に収まる。短く刈った黒髪、袖をまくった厚手の作業シャツ、太い首と厚い肩と太い腕。片手の拳を胸の前で握り、眉を寄せて静かに遠くを見据える。口は閉じる。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 夕方の港の埠頭。遠くの船と倉庫は簡単な形、空は白く残す。

shonen-mystery.en: Subject: A 20-year-old university student seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, his whole head and both hands inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. A big mop of tight curly hair, a plain turtleneck sweater under an open jacket. He rests two fingers against his chin and stares steadily at someone off to one side, thinking hard, lips closed. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: the study of an old Western-style mansion: tall bookshelves with plain spines, a desk with a tipped-over teacup, a window with white curtains.
shonen-mystery.ja: 題材: 20歳くらいの大学生の青年の腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手が画面に収まる。大きくふくらんだ細かい巻き毛、無地のタートルネックに前を開けた上着。2本の指をあごに当て、横にいる相手をじっと見つめて考え込む。口は閉じる。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 古い洋館の書斎。背が無地の本の並ぶ高い本棚、倒れたティーカップのある机、白いカーテンの窓。

shonen-period.en: Subject: A 16-year-old boy ninja seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, his whole head, both hands and the short blade inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. Short hair tied at the back, a long scarf-like cloth around his neck, a light dark-colored kimono with arm guards. He crouches low, holding a short blade in a reverse grip in front of his chest, the other hand held flat forward, sharp eyes glancing to the side. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: a bamboo grove path: bamboo stalks as flat vertical tone bands, leaves not drawn one by one, a few thin rays of light as white bands.
shonen-period.ja: 題材: 16歳くらいの少年の忍びの腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手と短い刀が画面に収まる。後ろで結んだ短い髪、首に長い布を巻き、黒っぽい軽い着物に手甲。低く身をかがめ、短い刀を逆手に胸の前で構え、もう片方の手を平らに前へ出し、鋭い目で横をうかがう。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 竹林の小道。竹は平らな縦のトーンの帯、葉は1枚ずつ描かない、差し込む光は白い帯を数本。

shonen-romcom.en: Subject: A gentle, graceful 17-year-old girl seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, her whole head and both hands inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. Long straight black hair, a neat school uniform with a round collar. Across the counter of a cake shop she holds a small cake box carefully in both hands and smiles softly toward the viewer, her eyes narrowed. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: inside a small cake shop after school: a glass showcase with cakes as simple rounded shapes, a counter, shelves not drawn item by item.
shonen-romcom.ja: 題材: おだやかで品のある17歳くらいの少女の腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手が画面に収まる。長いまっすぐな黒髪、きちんとした丸襟の制服。ケーキ屋のカウンター越しに、小さなケーキの箱を両手で大事そうに持ち、目を細めて正面へやわらかくほほえむ。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 放課後の小さなケーキ屋の店内。ガラスのショーケースのケーキは簡単な丸い形、カウンター、棚の品物は1つずつ描かない。

shonen-school.en: Subject: A 16-year-old boy seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, his whole head and both hands inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. A soft mushroom haircut, a white shirt with a loosened necktie, headphones hanging around his neck. He leans back against the rooftop fence, a half-eaten bread roll in one hand, the other hand raised in a casual wave, a relaxed friendly grin. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: the school rooftop at lunchtime: a chain-link fence as a few crossing lines, distant town roofs as flat silhouettes, the sky left white.
shonen-school.ja: 題材: 16歳くらいの少年の腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手が画面に収まる。やわらかいマッシュの髪、ネクタイをゆるめた白いシャツ、首に掛けたヘッドホン。屋上の柵に背をもたれ、片手に食べかけのパン、もう片方の手を軽く上げて、くつろいだ笑顔。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 昼休みの学校の屋上。金網の柵は交差する線を数本、遠くの町の屋根は平らな影、空は白く残す。

shonen-scifi.en: Subject: An 18-year-old boy pilot seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, his whole head, both hands and the helmet inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. Short hair, a fitted pilot suit with hard armor plates on the shoulders and chest and no markings. He holds his helmet under one arm and raises the other hand in a small wave, a confident smile. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: a huge hangar: behind him the lower leg and giant hand of a standing robot, drawn with ruled lines and flat tone; catwalks and cables as simple lines.
shonen-scifi.ja: 題材: 18歳くらいの少年のパイロットの腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手とヘルメットが画面に収まる。短い髪、肩と胸に硬い装甲板の付いた、体にぴったりしたパイロットスーツ（マークなし）。ヘルメットを片腕に抱え、もう片方の手を小さく上げて、自信のある笑顔。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 巨大な格納庫。背後に立つロボットの脚と大きな手を定規の線と平らなトーンで。通路とケーブルは簡単な線。

shonen-sports.en: Subject: A 17-year-old boy soccer striker seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, his whole head, both arms and the ball inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. Short hair damp with sweat and sticking to his forehead, a tight plain training shirt with no numbers or letters. He has just trapped the ball on his chest; the ball floats in front of his chest, his arms spread wide for balance. Wide-open eyes and a daring, hungry grin. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: an indoor training pitch at night: artificial turf as flat tone, a goal net as a few thin lines, the ceiling lights as white rectangles.
shonen-sports.ja: 題材: 17歳くらいの少年のサッカーのストライカーの腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両腕とボールが画面に収まる。汗で額に張りつく短い髪、番号も文字もない体にぴったりした練習着。胸でボールを受けた直後で、ボールが胸の前に浮かび、両腕を大きく広げて体を支える。目を見開き、不敵に笑う。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 夜の屋内練習場。人工芝は平らなトーン、ゴールのネットは細い線を数本、天井の照明は白い四角。

yonkoma-animal.en: Subject: A big fluffy dog and a chubby round cat sitting side by side on a sofa, both whole bodies in a tall vertical composition, both animals inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. The dog grins happily with its tongue out and its tail wagging; the cat sits upright and glares sideways at the dog with a grumpy face. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: a living room: the sofa as simple rounded shapes, a cushion, a window with curtains.
yonkoma-animal.ja: 題材: ソファに並んで座る大きなふわふわの犬とまるまる太ったねこの全身を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。2匹とも画面に収まる。犬は舌を出してうれしそうに笑い、しっぽを振る。ねこは背すじを伸ばして座り、不機嫌な顔で横目に犬をにらむ。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 居間。ソファは簡単な丸い形、クッション、カーテンの窓。

yonkoma-family.en: Subject: A mother of about 45 seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, her whole head and both hands inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. A round face, short permed hair, an apron over a sweater. She waves a ladle and scolds someone off to the side with a comically angry face, puffed cheeks and a big open mouth. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: a family dining room: a low table with dishes as simple shapes, a sliding door, a television as a plain dark box.
yonkoma-family.ja: 題材: 45歳くらいの母親の腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手が画面に収まる。丸い顔、短いパーマの髪、セーターにエプロン。お玉を振り回し、横にいる誰かをおおげさに怒った顔でしかる。ふくらんだ頬、大きく開けた口。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 家族の茶の間。低いテーブルの食器は簡単な形、ふすま、テレビは無地の暗い箱。

yonkoma-fantasy.en: Subject: A 15-year-old girl who manages a dungeon, seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, her whole head and both hands inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. Short hair, a hooded cloak over a simple dress. She holds up a lantern in one hand and a clipboard with a blank sheet in the other, checking the corridor with a serious, slightly tired face, while a tiny slime monster peeks at her feet. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: a stone dungeon corridor: stone walls as flat tone blocks, not drawn one by one, the lantern light as a white circle, the far end in solid black.
yonkoma-fantasy.ja: 題材: ダンジョンを管理する15歳くらいの少女の腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手が画面に収まる。短い髪、簡素なドレスにフード付きのマント。片手にランタン、もう片方の手に白紙をはさんだ板を持ち、まじめで少し疲れた顔で通路を点検する。足もとから小さなスライムがのぞく。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 石のダンジョンの通路。石の壁は平らなトーンのブロックで1つずつ描かない、ランタンの光は白い円、通路の奥は黒ベタ。

yonkoma-gag.en: Subject: A short girl in a tennis club uniform seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, her whole head, both hands and the racket inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. A round face, short hair, a sun visor. She swings a tennis racket wildly over her head with a crazed wide grin and spiral eyes, a tennis ball flying off in the wrong direction. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: a tennis court: the net as a few crossing lines, the court lines as white stripes, the fence as simple lines.
yonkoma-gag.ja: 題材: テニス部のユニフォームの小柄な少女の腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手とラケットが画面に収まる。丸い顔、短い髪、サンバイザー。テニスラケットを頭の上でめちゃくちゃに振り回し、うずまきの目で狂ったように大きく笑う。ボールは見当違いの方向へ飛んでいく。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: テニスコート。ネットは交差する線を数本、コートの線は白い帯、フェンスは簡単な線。

yonkoma-hobby.en: Subject: A 15-year-old girl who loves mountain climbing, seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, her whole head and both hands inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. A bucket hat, a light hiking jacket, a backpack. She holds trekking poles and stands at a mountain summit, out of breath but smiling happily, sweat drops on her face. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: a mountain summit: distant peaks as flat grey silhouettes, clouds below as flat tone, a small rock cairn.
yonkoma-hobby.ja: 題材: 山登りが好きな15歳くらいの少女の腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手が画面に収まる。バケットハット、軽い登山用の上着、リュック。トレッキングポールを持って山頂に立ち、息を切らしながらうれしそうに笑う。顔に汗のしずく。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 山頂。遠くの峰は平らな灰色の影、下の雲は平らなトーン、小さな石積み。

yonkoma-mochi.en: Subject: A child of about 5 seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, the whole head and both hands inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. A round knitted cap and a thick sweater. The child raises both little hands and smiles a small smile with teary eyes. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: a park by day: distant trees and clouds as simple lines, one bench.
yonkoma-mochi.ja: 題材: 5歳くらいの子どもの腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手が画面に収まる。丸いニット帽、厚手のセーター。両手を小さく上げて、目をうるませて小さく笑う。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 昼の公園。遠くの木と雲は簡単な線、ベンチ1つ。

yonkoma-newspaper.en: Subject: A father of about 50 seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, his whole head and both hands inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. Thinning hair, a cardigan over a shirt. He sits at a low table and holds up a newspaper with blank pages, peering over the top of it with a mildly surprised face; a cup of tea sits on the table. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: a tatami room: paper sliding doors as white panels, a low table, a potted plant.
yonkoma-newspaper.ja: 題材: 50歳くらいの父親の腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手が画面に収まる。薄くなった髪、シャツにカーディガン。低いテーブルに座り、紙面が無地の新聞を広げて持ち、上からのぞいて少し驚いた顔。テーブルに湯のみ。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 畳の部屋。障子は白い板、低いテーブル、鉢植え。

yonkoma-office.en: Subject: A young office worker of about 25 seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, his whole head and both hands inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. Messy short hair, a white shirt with a loose necktie. He lies slumped face-down on his desk, arms dangling, while a tiny white soul-shaped wisp floats out of his open mouth; exhausted swirl eyes. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: an office at dusk: stacks of documents as plain white shapes, a computer monitor with a blank screen, the window as a flat tone rectangle.
yonkoma-office.ja: 題材: 25歳くらいの若い会社員の男性の腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手が画面に収まる。乱れた短い髪、ネクタイのゆるんだ白いシャツ。机に突っ伏して腕をだらりと下げ、開いた口から小さな白い魂の形がふわりと抜け出す。疲れ切ったうずまきの目。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 夕方のオフィス。書類の山は無地の白い形、画面が無地のモニター、窓は平らなトーンの四角。

yonkoma-school.en: Subject: A shy 16-year-old girl seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, her whole head and both hands inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. Long hair with a hair clip, a zip-up track jacket over her school uniform. She hugs a guitar case in both arms and looks down, trembling nervously, sweat drops around her head and a wobbly forced smile. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: a school music room after class: a piano and chairs as simple shapes, a blank blackboard, windows as white rectangles.
yonkoma-school.ja: 題材: 内気な16歳くらいの少女の腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手が画面に収まる。ヘアクリップの長い髪、制服の上に前開きのジャージ。ギターケースを両腕で抱えてうつむき、緊張で震え、頭の周りに汗のしずく、ひきつった作り笑い。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 放課後の音楽室。ピアノといすは簡単な形、何も書かない黒板、窓は白い四角。

yonkoma-slice.en: Subject: A 15-year-old girl who works in a café, seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, her whole head and both hands inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. Long straight hair with a small hair ornament, a café waitress uniform with a frilled apron. She holds a round tray with a coffee cup and looks calm and a little sleepy, while a small fluffy cat sits on the counter beside her. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: a cozy wooden café: the counter and shelves as simple shapes, a window with lace curtains as flat pattern tone.
yonkoma-slice.ja: 題材: 喫茶店で働く15歳くらいの少女の腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手が画面に収まる。小さな髪飾りの長いまっすぐな髪、フリルのエプロンの給仕の制服。コーヒーカップをのせた丸いお盆を持ち、落ち着いて少し眠そうな顔。横のカウンターにふわふわの小さなねこが座る。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 木のあたたかい喫茶店。カウンターと棚は簡単な形、レースのカーテンの窓は平らな柄トーン。

yonkoma-story.en: Subject: A 16-year-old girl who studies art, seen from the waist up in a tall vertical composition, her whole head and both hands inside the picture, the surrounding background visible. Long wavy hair shown as pale tone, a school uniform with a loose cardigan. She sits on the outdoor stairs of an old apartment building, a sketchbook with a blank page on her knees and a pencil in her hand, looking up at someone with a warm smile. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. Setting: the outdoor staircase of an old apartment building: railings as ruled lines, potted plants, the sky left white.
yonkoma-story.ja: 題材: 美術を学ぶ16歳くらいの少女の腰から上を縦長の構図で、周りの背景とともに。頭全体と両手が画面に収まる。長いゆるい巻き髪（淡いトーン）、制服にゆったりしたカーディガン。古いアパートの外階段に座り、何も描いていないスケッチブックをひざにのせ鉛筆を持ち、誰かを見上げてあたたかく笑う。正面からやや斜めを向く。 場所: 古いアパートの外階段。手すりは定規の線、鉢植え、空は白く残す。

common.en: Full-color volumetric manga rendering with subdued ink outlines. Preserve base figure construction and render materials with continuous color shading rather than screentone.
common.ja: 輪郭を抑えた立体カラーの漫画描法。人物の形は土台に従い、材質と連続した色の陰影で描く。網点より色の階調を主体にする。

edit.en: Use the reference for people, pose, expression, composition and setting. Preserve figure shapes and redraw the whole scene in the specified volumetric color. Style: {look}. FINAL rendering: Full-color volumetric manga rendering with subdued ink outlines. Preserve base figure construction and render materials with continuous color shading rather than screentone. No text, balloons, borders, signatures or watermarks.
edit.ja: 元の絵は人物・ポーズ・表情・構図・場所の手本として使う。人物の形を保ち、全体を指定の立体カラーで描き直す。絵柄: {look}。最終の描法: 輪郭を抑えた立体カラーの漫画描法。人物の形は土台に従い、材質と連続した色の陰影で描く。網点より色の階調を主体にする。文字・フキダシ・コマ枠・署名・透かしなし。

common.en: Black-and-white Japanese manga panel. Form face, hair and body contours with rows of separate black dots. Shade only a few small areas with clusters of dots, leaving broad white space. No continuous outlines, dense stippling across whole surfaces, regular halftone or blur. Make an extremely sparse drawing. Faces have only simple eyes, a small nose and a mouth, without facial shading or extra lines. Hair is about three simple masses. Clothing has only its contour and two or three folds, with almost entirely white interiors. Shadows occupy small patches covering less than a fifth of the picture. Omit skin texture, individual hair strands, fabric patterns or weave, and hatching. Simplify all props to basic shapes. Indicate only one distant background shape and leave most of the paper completely white.
common.ja: モノクロの日本のマンガのコマ。顔・髪・体の輪郭を、離れた黒い点の列で作る。影は小さな点の塊だけにして、白を広く残す。連続した輪郭線、面を埋める細密な点描、規則的な網点、ぼかしは使わない。描き込みを極めて少なくする。顔は単純な目・小さな鼻・口だけで、顔に影や細線を足さない。髪は3個ほどの単純なまとまりにする。服は輪郭と2、3本のしわだけ、服の内側はほぼ白。影は全体の2割未満の小さな部分だけ。肌の細かな線、髪の一本一本、布の模様や織り目、ハッチングは描かない。小物も単純な形にする。背景は遠くの形を1個だけ示し、紙の大部分を完全な白で残す。
common.tags: monochrome, manga, dotted contours, sparse dot clusters, white space

edit.en: Draw very simple hand-drawn manga. No realistic rendering or detailed sparkling anime eyes. Take only the people, poses, expressions and setting from the reference and rebuild from scratch. Discard ALL original faces, lines, shading and detail. Drawing style: {look}. Black-and-white Japanese manga panel. Form face, hair and body contours with rows of separate black dots. Shade only a few small areas with clusters of dots, leaving broad white space. No continuous outlines, dense stippling across whole surfaces, regular halftone or blur. Make an extremely sparse drawing. Faces have only simple eyes, a small nose and a mouth, without facial shading or extra lines. Hair is about three simple masses. Clothing has only its contour and two or three folds, with almost entirely white interiors. Shadows occupy small patches covering less than a fifth of the picture. Omit skin texture, individual hair strands, fabric patterns or weave, and hatching. Simplify all props to basic shapes. Indicate only one distant background shape and leave most of the paper completely white. Draw the entire scene SMALL within the central two thirds of the canvas, with wide blank white margins on ALL FOUR sides. Complete heads and hands must fit inside those margins. No fine interior marks in the hair. Clothing shadows belong only in tiny areas inside collars or sleeves. No text, no letters, no numbers, no speech balloons, no sound-effect lettering, no panel borders or frame lines, no signature, no watermark. No color at all: strictly black, white and grey.
edit.ja: 非常に単純な手描きのマンガにする。写実的な描き込みや、細かくきらきらした目は使わない。元の絵から人物・ポーズ・表情・場所だけを取り出し、一から描き直す。元の顔・線・陰影・細部はすべて捨てる。絵柄: {look}。モノクロの日本のマンガのコマ。顔・髪・体の輪郭を、離れた黒い点の列で作る。影は小さな点の塊だけにして、白を広く残す。連続した輪郭線、面を埋める細密な点描、規則的な網点、ぼかしは使わない。描き込みを極めて少なくする。顔は単純な目・小さな鼻・口だけで、顔に影や細線を足さない。髪は3個ほどの単純なまとまりにする。服は輪郭と2、3本のしわだけ、服の内側はほぼ白。影は全体の2割未満の小さな部分だけ。肌の細かな線、髪の一本一本、布の模様や織り目、ハッチングは描かない。小物も単純な形にする。背景は遠くの形を1個だけ示し、紙の大部分を完全な白で残す。絵全体を紙の中央の3分の2の範囲に小さく収め、上下左右の端は広い白い余白にする。頭と手を余白の内側に全部収める。髪の内側に細線を足さず、服の影は襟や袖の奥の小さな部分だけにする。文字・数字・フキダシ・効果音の描き文字・コマ枠・署名・透かしを入れない。色は使わず、白黒とグレーだけで描く。

common.en: Very simple black-and-white manga. ONLY heads and hands retain ordinary shapes. The torso is a thin trapezoid PLATE. Each arm is TWO LONG, WIDE, FLAT RECTANGULAR STRIPS joined at sharp corners; each forearm is longer than the torso, ending in an ordinary hand. Shoulders are flat plates. No rounded arms, belly, muscles or cylindrical volume. Thin hard outlines, a little flat halftone, dot eyes, at most two clothing folds and one background shape. Mostly blank white paper.
common.ja: 白黒の単純なマンガ。頭と手だけは普通の形。胴は薄い台形の板、腕は幅のある長い長方形の帯2枚を角で折りつなぐ。前腕は胴より長く、先に普通の手が付く。肩も平たい板にして、丸い腕・腹・筋肉の立体感を省く。細い硬い輪郭、少量の網点、顔は点の目。服のしわは2本まで、背景の形は1個だけ。大半は白い紙。
common.tags: monochrome, manga, flat trapezoid torso, long wide strip arms, sharp corners, sparse outlines, white space

edit.en: Use the reference ONLY for character identity, pose and setting. Rebuild faces and bodies from scratch with radically different shapes; discard the original anatomical proportions and eyes. Drawing style: {look}. Very simple black-and-white manga. ONLY heads and hands retain ordinary shapes. The torso is a thin trapezoid PLATE. Each arm is TWO LONG, WIDE, FLAT RECTANGULAR STRIPS joined at sharp corners; each forearm is longer than the torso, ending in an ordinary hand. Shoulders are flat plates. No rounded arms, belly, muscles or cylindrical volume. Thin hard outlines, a little flat halftone, dot eyes, at most two clothing folds and one background shape. Mostly blank white paper. Keep complete heads and hands inside wide blank margins on all four sides. No text, no letters, no numbers, no speech balloons, no sound-effect lettering, no panel borders or frame lines, no signature, no watermark. No color at all: strictly black, white and grey.

common.en: Black-and-white Japanese manga panel. Use few pencil lines at essential places. Grey belongs only in shadows, as uneven patches with visible pencil grain and rubbing. Omit skin texture, individual hair strands, fabric patterns or weave, and hatching. Simplify all props to basic shapes. Indicate only one distant background shape and leave most of the paper completely white.

edit.ja: 指定の手描き漫画へ描き直す。元の目・髪細線・服の模様・陰影・細密背景をすべて消す。人物・しぐさ・表情だけを保ち、背景は仕上げ指定の最少の形へ置換。絵柄: {look}。最終の描法: 白黒の未清書の鉛筆下描き、完成清書にしない。探る二重輪郭と目立つ途切れ。髪は雑な外周3束、服はしわ2本。髪細線・清書輪郭・灰面なし。背景1形以外は白い紙。目は枝の形。文字・フキダシ・コマ枠・署名・透かし・色なし。

common.en: Black-and-white ukiyo-e manga. Thin uniform lines, FLAT black, grey and white areas; narrow upturned eyes, long nose. WHITE faces and necks. No shading or gloss. Simple setting shapes.
common.ja: 白黒の浮世絵漫画。細い均一な線、黒・灰・白の平らな面、顔は細い吊り目と長い鼻。顔と首は白。陰影と光沢を付けず、背景を簡単な形に省く。

common.en: Black-and-white manga. Clothes ONLY contours and TWO folds. WHITE faces and clothes, NO grey fills or fine detail. ONE background shape, the rest WHITE. Follow branch line and eye shapes.
common.ja: 白黒の漫画。服は輪郭としわ2本だけ、顔・服は白い紙。灰面と細密線なし。背景は形1個、残りは白。枝の線と目を優先。

Keep only character identity, gesture and expression. REPLACE scenery with the minimum shapes required by the FINISHED style. Style: {look}. FINAL drawing method: Black-and-white manga. Clothes ONLY contours and TWO folds. WHITE faces and clothes, NO grey fills or fine detail. ONE background shape, the rest WHITE. Follow branch line and eye shapes. edit.ja: 指定の手描き漫画へ描き直す。元の目・髪細線・服の模様・陰影・細密背景をすべて消す。人物・しぐさ・表情だけを保ち、背景は仕上げ指定の最少の形へ置換。絵柄: {look}。最終の描法: 白黒の漫画。服は輪郭としわ2本だけ、顔・服は白い紙。灰面と細密線なし。背景は形1個、残りは白。枝の線と目を優先。文字・フキダシ・コマ枠・署名・透かし・色なし。

common.en: Black-and-white Yamato-e manga. REPLACE the face with LOWER WIDE cheeks, TWO narrow horizontal eye DASHES without pupils, ONE short angular bent-line nose and TINY mouth. THIN uniform contours and WHITE clothing interiors. DELETE armor shading. ONE distant castle outline only. No blacks outside hair, no halftone or volumetric shading.
common.ja: 白黒の大和絵漫画。顔を下ぶくれに置換。目は瞳のない短い横線2本、鼻は短い折れ線、口は小さい線。細い均一な輪郭と白い衣服。鎧の陰影も消す。背景は遠い城の輪郭1個のみ。髪以外のベタ・網点・立体陰影なし。

common.en: Very simple black-and-white manga. Enlarge the eyes to occupy MOST OF THE UPPER HALF OF THE FACE. Each eye has TWO LARGE OVALS: the white-eye outer outline and a separate inner IRIS RING only slightly smaller. The iris interior is EMPTY WHITE except ONE extremely tiny black pupil dot. No eyelashes, highlights or iris texture. Hair is ONLY about THREE SIMPLE SOLID BLACK MASSES, with NO interior strands or white highlight lines. No facial shading or extra facial marks. Clothing interiors are almost entirely WHITE with at most TWO fold lines; show the apron with only a pale flat halftone patch. Background is ONE simple shelf shape. Mostly blank white paper.
common.ja: 白黒の単純なマンガ。目を顔の上半分の大半を占めるほど大きくし、それぞれ白目の外形と内側の虹彩の輪を大きな楕円2個で描く。虹彩の輪は目の外形より少し小さく、内側は白いまま。瞳孔はごく小さな点1個。まつげ・光・虹彩の模様は描かない。髪は細線や白いつやの筋を足さず、3個ほどの単純な黒い形だけ。顔に影や細線を足さない。服の内側はほぼ白、しわは2本まで。背景は本棚の形1個だけ。大半は白い紙。
common.tags: monochrome, manga, oversized double-oval eyes, large empty white iris rings, tiny pupils, sparse lines, white space

edit.en: Use the reference ONLY for character identity, pose and setting. Rebuild faces and bodies from scratch with radically different shapes; discard the original anatomical proportions and eyes. Drawing style: {look}. Very simple black-and-white manga. Enlarge the eyes to occupy MOST OF THE UPPER HALF OF THE FACE. Each eye has TWO LARGE OVALS: the white-eye outer outline and a separate inner IRIS RING only slightly smaller. The iris interior is EMPTY WHITE except ONE extremely tiny black pupil dot. No eyelashes, highlights or iris texture. Hair is ONLY about THREE SIMPLE SOLID BLACK MASSES, with NO interior strands or white highlight lines. No facial shading or extra facial marks. Clothing interiors are almost entirely WHITE with at most TWO fold lines; show the apron with only a pale flat halftone patch. Background is ONE simple shelf shape. Mostly blank white paper. Keep complete heads and hands inside wide blank margins on all four sides. No text, no letters, no numbers, no speech balloons, no sound-effect lettering, no panel borders or frame lines, no signature, no watermark. No color at all: strictly black, white and grey. Draw the ENTIRE picture SMALL inside the central 60 percent of BOTH canvas width and height. Leave 20 percent of the canvas completely BLANK WHITE on EACH of all four sides. The top of the hair must start at least 20 percent below the top edge.
edit.ja: 元の絵から人物・ポーズ・場所だけを取り、顔と体の形を一から変えて描く。絵柄: {look}。白黒の単純なマンガ。目を顔の上半分の大半を占めるほど大きくし、それぞれ白目の外形と内側の虹彩の輪を大きな楕円2個で描く。虹彩の輪は目の外形より少し小さく、内側は白いまま。瞳孔はごく小さな点1個。まつげ・光・虹彩の模様は描かない。髪は細線や白いつやの筋を足さず、3個ほどの単純な黒い形だけ。顔に影や細線を足さない。服の内側はほぼ白、しわは2本まで。背景は本棚の形1個だけ。大半は白い紙。頭と手をすべて入れ、四辺に広い白い余白を残す。文字・数字・フキダシ・効果音の描き文字・コマ枠・署名・透かしを入れない。色は使わず、白黒とグレーだけで描く。絵全体は画面中央の幅・高さ6割の中に小さく収め、四辺に2割ずつ完全に白い余白を残す。頭頂も画面の上から2割以上下に置く。

common.en: Monochrome Japanese manga. No outer contour lines on faces, hair, clothes or backgrounds. Define forms with boundaries between white, two densities of flat halftone and a little solid black. Keep eyes and mouths as tiny internal shapes. No fine interior lines in hair or clothes, patterns, hatching or blur. Only one distant background shape; most of the paper is blank white.
common.ja: モノクロの日本のマンガ。顔・髪・服・背景の外周の線を引かず、白・濃さ2種類の平らな網点・少量の黒の面の境で形を作る。目と口は小さな形だけ残す。髪や服を細線で埋めず、模様・ハッチング・ぼかしを使わない。背景は遠くの形1個だけにし、紙の大半は白い余白。
common.tags: monochrome, manga, no outlines, two-density halftone shapes, sparse detail, white space

edit.en: Draw very simple hand-drawn manga. No realistic rendering or detailed sparkling anime eyes. Take only the people, poses, expressions and setting from the reference and rebuild from scratch. Discard ALL original faces, lines, shading and detail. Drawing style: {look}. Monochrome Japanese manga. No outer contour lines on faces, hair, clothes or backgrounds. Define forms with boundaries between white, two densities of flat halftone and a little solid black. Keep eyes and mouths as tiny internal shapes. No fine interior lines in hair or clothes, patterns, hatching or blur. Only one distant background shape; most of the paper is blank white. Draw the entire scene SMALL within the central two thirds of the canvas, with wide blank white margins on ALL FOUR sides. Complete heads and hands must fit inside those margins. No fine interior marks in the hair. Clothing shadows belong only in tiny areas inside collars or sleeves. No text, no letters, no numbers, no speech balloons, no sound-effect lettering, no panel borders or frame lines, no signature, no watermark. No color at all: strictly black, white and grey.
edit.ja: 非常に単純な手描きのマンガにする。写実的な描き込みや、細かくきらきらした目は使わない。元の絵から人物・ポーズ・表情・場所だけを取り出し、一から描き直す。元の顔・線・陰影・細部はすべて捨てる。絵柄: {look}。モノクロの日本のマンガ。顔・髪・服・背景の外周の線を引かず、白・濃さ2種類の平らな網点・少量の黒の面の境で形を作る。目と口は小さな形だけ残す。髪や服を細線で埋めず、模様・ハッチング・ぼかしを使わない。背景は遠くの形1個だけにし、紙の大半は白い余白。絵全体を紙の中央の3分の2の範囲に小さく収め、上下左右の端は広い白い余白にする。頭と手を余白の内側に全部収める。髪の内側に細線を足さず、服の影は襟や袖の奥の小さな部分だけにする。文字・数字・フキダシ・効果音の描き文字・コマ枠・署名・透かしを入れない。色は使わず、白黒とグレーだけで描く。

common.en: Color manga rendering. contours with the base weight and pressure. skin and clothes in uniform flat colors, with a few simple flat shadow shapes. Preserve base figure construction and change only the coloring method.
common.ja: カラー漫画の描法。土台の太さと強弱の輪郭線。肌と服は均一な多色ベタ、影は少量の単純な色面。人物の形は土台に従い、彩色の描法だけを変える。

FINAL medium: Color manga rendering. contours with the base weight and pressure. skin and clothes in uniform flat colors, with a few simple flat shadow shapes. Preserve base figure construction and change only the coloring method. No text, balloons, borders, signatures or watermarks.
edit.ja: 元の絵は人物・ポーズ・表情・構図・場所の手本として使う。人物の形を保ち、全体を指定の彩色描法で描き直す。絵柄: {look}。最終の画材: カラー漫画の描法。土台の太さと強弱の輪郭線。肌と服は均一な多色ベタ、影は少量の単純な色面。人物の形は土台に従い、彩色の描法だけを変える。文字・フキダシ・コマ枠・署名・透かしなし。

summary.en: Energetic, hot-blooded mainstream style for young readers.
summary.ja: 勢いと熱さのある、王道の少年向けの絵柄。

words.en: shonen manga art: bold, energetic drawing with strong black-and-white contrast; thick, confident dip-pen outlines with clear thick-to-thin variation; eyes smaller than in shojo manga, with sharp upper lids, one small white highlight and no drawn lashes; the nose a small simple mark, the mouth a single line, blush as a few short diagonal hatch lines; hair as a solid black mass split into sharp-pointed locks at the tips, with one or two white highlight bands, lines only on the tips; large solid black shadow areas on the hair, clothes and shadow side of the body; 6 to 7 heads tall; no pattern tones, stippling or all-over fine hatching; the background drawn with clear depth, with a few hand-ruled speed lines; a straightforward, energetic character
words.ja: 少年漫画の絵。白と黒のコントラストが強い、力強く勢いのある絵。太く力強い輪郭線で、入り抜きをはっきり。目は少女漫画より小さめで、上まぶたを鋭く描き、白い光は小さく1つ、まつげは描かない。鼻は小さな線、口は1本の線、頬の赤みは短い斜線。髪は毛先をとがった房に分けた黒ベタのかたまりで、白い帯を1〜2本抜き、線は毛先だけ。髪・服・体の影側を大きな黒ベタで塗る。6〜7頭身。柄トーンや点描、全面の細かい線影は使わない。背景は奥行きをはっきり描き、手で引いたスピード線を数本。まっすぐで元気な人物
words.tags: shonen manga, strong contrast, thick outlines, heavy blacks, smaller sharp eyes, speed lines

summary.en: Fists and special moves clashing in fights.
summary.ja: 拳や技がぶつかり合う戦いの絵柄。

words.en: shonen battle manga style: rough, thick, heavy-pressure lines; hard contrast with large solid blacks on the hair, clothes, the shadow side of the body and half of the background; narrow, upturned eyes with small, sharp irises; thick raised eyebrows; a few focus lines in the background
words.ja: バトル漫画の絵柄。荒々しく太い、筆圧の強い線。髪・服・体の影と背景の半分を大きな黒ベタで塗る強い明暗。目は細くつり上がり、黒目は小さく鋭い。眉は太く上がる。背景に集中線を数本
words.tags: shonen battle, rough thick lines, heavy solid blacks, narrow sharp eyes, thick brows, focus lines

summary.en: Sweat and split-second motion of sport.
summary.ja: 汗と一瞬の躍動を見せるスポーツの絵柄。

words.en: shonen sports manga style: crisp, clean lines of even weight; a bright, airy picture: dark clothes rendered in pale halftone instead of solid black, black only on the hair; large, clear, straightforward eyes with two white highlights; a lean, athletic neck and shoulders; sweat drops and horizontal speed lines streaming across the background
words.ja: スポーツ漫画の絵柄。くっきりした太さのそろった線。明るく軽い画面: 黒い服はベタでなく淡い網点トーンで、黒は髪だけ。目は大きく澄んで白い光を2つ。首と肩は引き締まった体つき。汗のしずくと、背景に横に流れるスピード線
words.tags: shonen sports, clean even lines, bright white page, clear large eyes, sweat drops, speed lines

summary.en: Bright, lively love and laughter.
summary.ja: 明るく賑やかな恋と笑いの絵柄。

words.en: romantic comedy style: thin, soft lines; large round eyes with three white highlights; a rounder, boyish face; diagonal blush strokes on the cheeks; shading only in pale halftone, solid black only on the hair
words.ja: ラブコメの絵柄。細く柔らかい線。目は大きく丸く、白い光を3つ。輪郭は丸く、あどけない顔。頬に赤面の斜線。陰影は明るい網点トーンだけで、黒は髪だけ
words.tags: romantic comedy, thin soft lines, large round eyes, round boyish face, blush strokes, pale halftone

summary.en: Worlds of swords and magic.
summary.ja: 剣と魔法の世界を描く絵柄。

words.en: fantasy adventure manga style: fine, careful lines; hair drawn as long, curving, flowing locks instead of spikes; fairly large eyes with two white highlights; the sky and background in layered screentone whose dot density changes in visible steps; a few small light shapes cut out of the tone as white
words.ja: ファンタジーの絵柄。細くていねいな線。髪はとがった房でなく、長く曲線で流れる房。目は大きめで白い光を2つ。空と背景は網点の濃さを段階的に変えたトーンを重ねる。光はトーンを白く抜いた小さな形を数個
words.tags: fantasy adventure, fine careful lines, flowing hair, fairly large eyes, layered screentone sky, white sparkles

summary.en: The tension of riddles and deduction.
summary.ja: 謎と推理の緊張を描く絵柄。

words.en: mystery manga style: thin, sharp lines; narrow, cool eyes with small irises; the whole picture covered in darker flat screentone, a solid black shadow over half of the face; white only on the lit side of the face
words.ja: ミステリーの絵柄。細くシャープな線。目は切れ長で冷静、黒目は小さい。画面全体を暗めの平らなトーンで覆い、顔の半分に黒い影を落とす。白は顔の光の側だけ
words.tags: mystery, thin sharp lines, narrow cool eyes, dark flat tone, half-face shadow

summary.en: Machines and futuristic worlds.
summary.ja: 機械と未来の世界を描く絵柄。

words.en: sci-fi mecha manga style: hard, even, ruler-like lines, the face and body built from angular planes with straight edges; smaller, sharp eyes with no white highlights; hair as a few large angular black shapes; surfaces divided cleanly into white and flat tone, no glow
words.ja: SF・メカの絵柄。定規で引いたような硬く均一な線で、顔も体もまっすぐな辺の角ばった面で組み立てる。目は小さめで鋭く、白い光はない。髪は大きな角ばった黒い形を数個。面は白と平らなトーンではっきり塗り分け、光はにじませない
words.tags: sci-fi mecha, ruler-like lines, angular forms, sharp eyes without highlights, flat tone planes

summary.en: Journeys across a wide world.
summary.ja: 広い世界を旅する冒険の絵柄。

words.en: classic adventure manga style: thick, rounded, lively lines; a rounder face with big round eyes and one white highlight; a bigger head, about 5 heads tall; simple rounded hair shapes; no screentone at all, strong sunlight shown with black and white only
words.ja: 昔ながらの冒険漫画の絵柄。太く丸みのある元気な線。丸い顔に大きな丸い目、白い光を1つ。頭を大きく、約5頭身。髪は丸みのある簡単な形。トーンは使わず、白と黒だけで強い日差しの明暗を描く
words.tags: classic adventure, thick rounded lines, big round eyes, 5 heads tall, no screentone, sunlight contrast

summary.en: School days spent with friends.
summary.ja: 仲間と過ごす学校生活の絵柄。

words.en: school-life manga style: thin, delicate lines of even weight; eyes of near-realistic size with two small highlights, a neat, true-to-life face with a slimmer jaw; about 7 heads tall; the clothes in pale halftone instead of solid black; sunlight as diagonal white bands cut out of the tone
words.ja: 学園漫画の絵柄。細く繊細な、太さのそろった線。目は現実に近い大きさで小さな光を2つ、あごの細い整った等身大の顔。約7頭身。服はベタでなく淡い網点トーン。日差しはトーンを白く抜いた斜めの帯
words.tags: school life, thin delicate lines, near-realistic eyes, 7 heads tall, pale halftone, sunlight bands

summary.en: Brawls and friendship among tough kids.
summary.ja: 喧嘩と友情の不良ものの絵柄。

words.en: delinquent manga style: sanpaku eyes, small irises with white showing on three sides; short, thick eyebrows; a square-jawed face; thick, rough lines, large solid black shadows on the clothes
words.ja: 不良漫画の絵柄。目は三白眼（黒目を小さく、白目を三方に見せる）。眉は太く短い。あごは角ばった輪郭。太く荒い線で、服の影を大きな黒ベタで塗る
words.tags: delinquent, sanpaku eyes, short thick brows, square jaw, rough thick lines, heavy blacks

summary.en: Swords and kimono in historical settings.
summary.ja: 刀と着物の時代ものの絵柄。

words.en: period-drama manga style drawn with an ink brush: every outline is a brush stroke that swells thick and tapers to a sharp point, fewer and bolder strokes; the hair as large black brush masses ending in flicked tips; long, narrow eyes under sharp brows; solid black shadows laid first to carve out the forms; a few dry-brush streaks with split, scratchy edges
words.ja: 筆で描く時代劇の絵柄。輪郭はすべて、太く入って細くとがって抜ける筆の線で、本数は少なく大胆に。髪は大きな黒い筆の塊で、毛先ははね上げて抜く。目は切れ長で眉は鋭い。影の黒を先に塗って形を切り出す。かすれた筆の跡を数本
words.tags: period drama, ink brush strokes, brush-mass hair, long narrow eyes, carved black shadows, dry brush

summary.en: Parallel lines carved across the face and full dark lips; flamboyant.
summary.ja: 顔に平行線を刻み、唇を厚く塗る、奇抜で華やかな絵柄。

title.ja: 顔を線で刻む奇抜な美形

words.en: flamboyant carved-face style: bundles of parallel lines like contour lines drawn across the cheeks, forehead and nose bridge, carving the planes of the face; full, outlined lips filled dark even on men; hair as hard, pattern-like masses; shadows as dense bundles of diagonal hatching
words.ja: 顔を線で刻む奇抜な美形の絵柄。頬・額・鼻筋に、等高線のような平行線の束を引いて顔の面を刻む。唇は男でも厚く輪郭を描いて黒く塗る。髪は模様のような硬い塊。影は濃い斜線の束
words.tags: flamboyant, parallel contour lines on the face, full dark lips, patterned hair masses, diagonal hatching

summary.en: Fine lines layered on white paper carve out faces and muscles.
summary.ja: 白い紙に細い線を重ねて、顔と筋肉を彫り出す劇画調の絵柄。

words.en: line-carved gekiga-like shonen style: on white paper, layers of fine parallel pen lines carve the planes of the face and the muscles; almost no screentone or solid black; an adult man's bone structure: thick dark eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a square jaw; hair drawn as hundreds of fine flowing lines
words.ja: 線で彫る劇画調の絵柄。白い紙に、細いペンの平行線を重ねて顔の凹凸と筋肉を彫る。トーンと黒ベタはほとんど使わない。大人の男の骨格: 太く濃い眉、深くくぼんだ目、角ばったあご。髪は細い線を何百本も流す
words.tags: line-carved shading, white paper, fine parallel pen lines, deep-set eyes, thick brows, square jaw, no tone

summary.en: Delicate lines and sparkling eyes that show the heart.
summary.ja: 繊細な線ときらめく瞳で気持ちを描く、少女向けの絵柄。

words.en: shojo manga art: delicate, graceful drawing with thin, soft lines; very large eyes that are the most prominent feature of the face, black or toned irises with three or four white highlights of different sizes, long thick upper lashes and drawn lower lashes; the nose a small simple mark, a small single-line mouth, blush as a few short diagonal hatch lines; hair as a black or screentone mass with one or two white highlight bands, lines only on the tips; slim neck and arms, slender, 7 to 8 heads tall; no all-over fine hatching; one sheet of flower-and-sparkle pattern tone behind the figure; a sensitive character whose feelings show softly on the face
words.ja: 少女漫画の絵。繊細で華やかな絵。細く柔らかい線。目はとても大きく、顔の中でいちばん目立つ。黒目は黒ベタかトーンで、白い光を大小3〜4個抜き、上まつげは太く長い線を数本、下まつげも描く。鼻は小さな線、口は小さな1本の線、頬の赤みは短い斜線。髪は黒ベタかトーンのかたまりで、白い帯を1〜2本抜き、線は毛先だけ。首と腕は細く、すらりとした7〜8頭身。全面の細かい線影はしない。人物の後ろに花やきらめきの柄トーンを1枚。気持ちが表情ににじむ繊細な人物
words.tags: shojo manga, very large sparkling eyes, long lashes, slender, flower pattern tone

summary.en: Love blossoming in the classroom.
summary.ja: 教室で芽生える恋の絵柄。

words.en: school-romance shojo style: eyes enlarged to nearly a third of the face height, each with five or six sparkling white highlights of different sizes; long, full upper lashes; the hair in light halftone with a broad white shine band instead of a solid black mass; diagonal blush strokes on the cheeks; petal-pattern screentone behind the figure
words.ja: 学園恋愛の絵柄。目を顔の高さの3分の1近くまで大きくし、大小の白い光を5〜6個。上まつげは長く多く。髪は黒ベタをやめ、淡い網点トーンに太い白いつやの帯。頬に赤面の斜線、人物の後ろに花びらの柄トーン
words.tags: school romance shojo, very large sparkling eyes, full lashes, light halftone hair, blush strokes, petal tone

summary.en: Bright love with ever-changing expressions.
summary.ja: くるくる変わる表情の明るい恋の絵柄。

words.en: romantic-comedy shojo style: slightly bolder, lively lines; a round face with a small chin and a bigger head, about 5 heads tall; big round eyes with two white highlights and only two or three short lashes; the hair as a few big black shapes with few strand lines; large blush strokes on the cheeks; one small heart symbol
words.ja: ラブコメの絵柄。やや太く元気な線。顔は丸くあごは小さく、頭を大きめの5頭身。目は大きな丸で白い光は2つ、まつげは短く2〜3本だけ。髪は毛の線の少ない大きな黒い形。頬に大きな赤面の斜線、小さなハートの漫符を1つ
words.tags: romcom shojo, lively bold lines, round childlike face, big round eyes, few lashes, heart symbol

summary.en: Dreamlike worlds of gowns and magic.
summary.ja: ドレスと魔法の幻想の絵柄。

words.en: fantasy shojo style: a more mature, elegant face, longer and narrower, with almond-shaped eyes whose outer corners turn up and small patterned highlights in the irises; the long hair streaming in wide curves in the wind, in dark halftone instead of solid black; fine, careful lines; ornamental vine-and-flower pattern screentone behind the figure
words.ja: ファンタジーの絵柄。大人びた気品のある顔: 面長で、目はつり気味の切れ長、瞳に小さな模様のような光。長い髪は風に大きく流れる曲線の房で、黒ベタでなく濃い網点トーン。細くていねいな線。人物の後ろに、つると花の装飾的な柄トーン
words.tags: fantasy shojo, mature elegant face, almond eyes, flowing toned hair, vine and flower pattern tone

summary.en: Court romance in lavish costumes.
summary.ja: 豪華な衣装の宮廷ロマンの絵柄。

words.en: classic palace-romance style of older girls' comics: a long, slender face with a pointed chin and a tiny mouth; enormous eyes about a third of the face height, each iris holding one large square white highlight and a few small stars, long lashes fanning outward like rays; a small highlight on the lips; lace-pattern screentone behind the figure
words.ja: 昔の少女漫画風の宮廷ロマンの絵柄。細長い顔にとがったあご、小さな口。目は顔の高さの3分の1ほどもあり、瞳に大きな四角い白い光と小さな星、まつげは放射状に長く。唇に小さな光。人物の後ろにレースの柄トーン
words.tags: classic palace romance, slender face, enormous starry eyes, square highlights, ray lashes, lace tone

summary.en: Magical girls who transform and fight.
summary.ja: 変身して戦う魔法少女の絵柄。

words.en: style of girls' magazines for young readers: a much younger look: a round face with full cheeks and a big head, about 4 to 5 heads tall; huge, perfectly round eyes with star-shaped white highlights; thicker, rounder, simpler lines, the hair as big shapes with few strand lines; a few star and heart shapes cut out of the tone as white
words.ja: 低学年向け少女誌の絵柄。ずっと幼い見た目: 丸い顔にふっくらした頬、頭を大きく4〜5頭身。目は真ん丸でとても大きく、瞳に星形の白い光。線は太めで丸く単純、髪は毛の線の少ない大きな形。トーンを白く抜いた星やハートを数個
words.tags: young girl readers style, round young face, huge round eyes, star highlights, 4 to 5 heads tall, cut-out stars

summary.en: Performers shining on stage.
summary.ja: ステージで輝く芸能ものの絵柄。

words.en: idol showbiz style: a glamorous face with thick, long lashes above and below the eyes, star-shaped white highlights in the irises and glossy lips; black hair crossed by several bold white shine bands; the background in dark tone cut by white spotlight beams, with a few small confetti squares
words.ja: 芸能・アイドルの絵柄。華やかな顔: 上下に太く長いまつげ、瞳に星形の白い光、唇につや。黒髪に太い白いつやの帯を何本も。背景は暗いトーンを白いスポットライトの帯が切り、小さな四角の紙吹雪を数個
words.tags: idol showbiz shojo, glamorous face, thick long lashes, star highlights, glossy hair bands, spotlight beams

summary.en: Supple, graceful dancing.
summary.ja: しなやかな踊りを見せる絵柄。

words.en: ballet and dance shojo style: very thin, light, supple lines; a small, narrow face with a pointed chin on a long, slender neck; long, narrow eyes with lowered lids and long lashes; the hair made light, a few long curves with much white inside instead of a heavy black mass; a few lines of flowing movement
words.ja: バレエ・ダンスの絵柄。ごく細く軽い、しなやかな線。小さく細い顔にとがったあご、長く細い首。目は切れ長でまぶたを少し伏せ、まつげは長い。髪は重い黒ベタをやめ、長い曲線数本と白い面で軽く。流れる動きの線を数本
words.tags: ballet and dance shojo, very thin supple lines, narrow face, long slender neck, light airy hair, flowing lines

summary.en: Shojo suspense full of unease and secrets.
summary.ja: 不安と謎が漂う少女サスペンスの絵柄。

words.en: suspense shojo style: only one small white highlight in each iris, thin, sparse lashes; a solid black shadow over half of the face, the background in dark flat tone
words.ja: サスペンスの絵柄。瞳の白い光は小さく1つだけ、まつげは細く少なく。顔の半分に黒い影をかけ、背景は暗い平らなトーン
words.tags: suspense shojo, single small highlight, sparse lashes, half-face black shadow, dark flat tone

summary.en: Quiet stories of family and friendship.
summary.ja: 家族や友情を静かに描く絵柄。

words.en: human-drama shojo style: a quiet, more realistic face: eyes of near-realistic size with smaller irises and one small white highlight; a small drawn nose and lips, a slightly older look; the hair in flat grey halftone instead of solid black; thin, quiet lines; light as diagonal white bands cut out of the tone
words.ja: ヒューマンドラマの絵柄。静かで写実寄りの顔: 目は現実に近い大きさで瞳は小さく、白い光は小さく1つ。鼻と唇を小さく描き、少し大人びた顔。髪は黒ベタでなく平らな灰色のトーン。線は細く静か。光はトーンを白く抜いた斜めの帯
words.tags: human drama shojo, quiet realistic face, smaller irises, grey tone hair, thin quiet lines, light bands

summary.en: Shojo sci-fi set in space and the future.
summary.ja: 宇宙と未来を舞台にした少女SFの絵柄。

words.en: sci-fi shojo style: thin, even, ruler-like lines; a sharper face with a pointed chin; narrower, keen eyes with one small white highlight and short lashes; the hair as smooth black shapes with a single hard-edged white shine and no strand lines; no flower or pattern ornaments, surfaces divided into white and flat tone
words.ja: SFの絵柄。定規で引いたような細く均一な線。顔はとがったあごのシャープな形。目は細めで鋭く、白い光は小さく1つ、まつげは短い。髪は毛の線を描かず、つるりとした黒い面に硬い形の白いつやを1本。花や柄の飾りはなく、面は白と平らなトーン
words.tags: sci-fi shojo, ruler-like thin lines, sharp face, keen eyes, sleek hair, no ornaments, flat tone

summary.en: Small eyes, a white page and hand-drawn little flowers; gentle.
summary.ja: 小さな目と白い画面、手描きの小花の、ほのぼのした絵柄。

words.en: 1970s otome-chic shojo style: thin, light pen lines; a small round face; instead of huge sparkling eyes, small oval black eyes with a few short lashes, a dot nose and a small mouth; fluffy curly hair drawn in line only; almost no screentone, a mostly white page; a few small hand-drawn flowers and little birds in the corners
words.ja: 70年代の乙女ちっくの絵柄。細く軽いペンの線。小さな丸い顔に、大きな瞳をやめて小さな楕円の黒目と短いまつげ数本。髪はふわふわの巻き毛を線だけで。トーンはほぼ使わない白い画面。隅に手描きの小花と小鳥を数個
words.tags: 1970s otome-chic, thin light lines, small oval eyes, small round face, line-drawn curly hair, white page

summary.en: Eyes half the face, full of stars, in flower-decked line art.
summary.ja: 顔の半分ほどの星の瞳と、花で飾る線画の絵柄。

words.en: Showa-era lyrical shojo illustration style: a young, round, childlike face with enormous eyes filling almost half of it; inside each iris a white star and several rings of light; long lashes radiating above and below; a dot nose and a tiny mouth; big roses decorating the hair; fine line art with no screentone
words.ja: 昭和の抒情的な少女画の絵柄。幼い丸顔に、顔の半分近い巨大な瞳。瞳の中に白い星と何重もの光の輪、上下に放射状の長いまつげ。鼻は点、口はごく小さく。髪を大輪のバラで飾る。トーンを使わない細い線画
words.tags: Showa lyrical shojo, enormous starry eyes, rings of light, radiating lashes, round child face, line art

summary.en: No tone; refined faces and curls in fine pen lines only.
summary.ja: トーンを使わず、細いペンの線だけで端正な顔と巻き毛を描く絵柄。

title.ja: ペン線だけの端正な少女漫画

words.en: pen-line-only refined shojo style: no screentone at all, drawn only with very fine pen lines; instead of huge eyes, almond-shaped eyes of near-realistic size, each iris drawn with fine radiating lines and one small highlight; a long, refined face; short curly hair filled with small swirling lines
words.ja: ペン線だけの端正な少女漫画の絵柄。トーンを使わず、ごく細いペンの線だけで描く。目は大きな瞳をやめ、現実に近い大きさのアーモンド形。黒目に細い放射線を引き、光は小さく1つ。面長の端正な顔。短い巻き毛を小さな渦の線で埋める
words.tags: pen lines only, no screentone, almond eyes, radiating iris lines, refined long face, swirl-line curly hair

summary.en: Mature faces and grounded, realistic panels for adults.
summary.ja: 大人びた顔立ちと現実味のある画面の、大人向けの絵柄。

words.en: seinen manga art: realistic drawing with a calm, grown-up atmosphere; few lines, firm lines of even weight on the contours; a realistic, mature face with small, realistically shaped eyes, small pupils and tiny highlights, lashes not emphasized; the nose and lips as short, small lines; shading done only with flat grey screentone in a clear light direction; solid black only on the hair and a few small areas; realistic proportions, 7 to 8 heads tall; the background given depth with flat tone areas and few lines; a quiet, understated, sophisticated picture; a character with a mature, grown-up air
words.ja: 青年漫画の絵。落ち着いた大人の雰囲気の、現実味のある絵。線は少なく、太さのそろった確かな線で輪郭を引く。写実寄りの大人びた顔立ちで、目は小さく現実に近い形、黒目は小さく、白い光はごく小さい。まつげは強調しない。鼻と唇は短く小さな線。陰影は光の向きを決めて、平らな灰色のトーンだけで塗る。黒ベタは髪など少しだけ。7〜8頭身の現実的な体つき。背景は平らなトーンの面で遠近を出し、線は少ない。静かで洗練された画面。大人びた雰囲気の人物
words.tags: seinen manga, realistic, calm grown-up mood, small eyes, flat grey tone shading, few lines

summary.en: Grown-up action with guns and fists.
summary.ja: 銃と格闘の大人のアクションの絵柄。

words.en: action seinen style: fast, rough outlines with strong thick-to-thin variation, few in number; hard contrast with half of the face and body in solid black; narrow, sharp eyes under a deeply furrowed brow; a few short motion strokes
words.ja: アクションの絵柄。速く荒い、強弱の大きい輪郭の線を少ない本数で。顔の半分と服を黒ベタにした強い明暗。目は細く鋭く、眉間に深いしわ。動きを表す短い線を数本
words.tags: action seinen, fast rough outlines, half-face solid black, narrow sharp eyes, furrowed brow, motion strokes

summary.en: Noir stories of the night underworld.
summary.ja: 夜の裏社会を描くノワールの絵柄。

words.en: crime-noir seinen style: most of the picture a solid black night, the shadow side of the face also black; white only on the lit side of the face and the wet ground; hollow cheeks, narrow, cold eyes with no highlight
words.ja: 犯罪・裏社会の絵柄。画面の大半を黒ベタの夜にし、顔の影の側も黒く塗る。白は顔の光の側と濡れた地面だけ。頬はこけ、目は細く冷たく、白い光はない
words.tags: crime noir seinen, solid black night, lit half face, hollow cheeks, cold eyes without highlights

summary.en: Precisely drawn future worlds.
summary.ja: 精密な未来世界を描く絵柄。

words.en: sci-fi seinen style: thin, hard, ruler-like straight lines for the figure and the background; a symmetrical face with an angular jaw, the hair as smooth shapes with no strand lines; surfaces divided into several steps of flat tone
words.ja: SFの絵柄。定規で引いたような細く硬い直線で、人物も背景も描く。顔は角ばったあごの左右の整った形、髪は毛の線を描かないつるりとした形。面は平らなトーンを何段階かに塗り分ける
words.tags: sci-fi seinen, thin ruled lines, symmetrical angular face, smooth hair, stepped flat tones

summary.en: Heavy fantasy steeped in darkness.
summary.ja: 闇の匂いのする重い幻想の絵柄。

words.en: dark-fantasy seinen style: sharp, thin lines in a heavy picture of layered dark tone; a gaunt, sharp face, the eyes sunk in shadow with no highlight; white left only on the lit side of the figure
words.ja: ダークファンタジーの絵柄。鋭く細い線で、暗いトーンを重ねた重い画面。顔はこけて鋭く、目は影に沈んで白い光はない。人物の光の側だけを白く残す
words.tags: dark fantasy seinen, sharp thin lines, layered dark tone, gaunt face, shadowed eyes

summary.en: Weighty stories of battle and history.
summary.ja: 戦いと歴史を重厚に描く絵柄。

words.en: war-chronicle seinen style: the whole picture covered in flat grey tone, with little white or black, a subdued picture; hollow cheeks and shadows under the eyes, a worn-out face; a few small black specks of ash
words.ja: 戦記の絵柄。全体を平らな灰色のトーンで覆い、白と黒を控えめにした沈んだ画面。頬はこけ、目の下に影、疲れた顔。灰は小さな黒い点を数個
words.tags: war chronicle seinen, flat grey tone, subdued contrast, hollow cheeks, tired eyes, ash specks

summary.en: The psychology of high-stakes games.
summary.ja: 張りつめた勝負の心理を描く絵柄。

words.en: high-stakes gambling seinen style: a face with a long, sharply pointed chin and nose; small pupils in wide whites; a deep solid black shadow over the lower face and neck, light only on the forehead and cheeks; one or two drops of cold sweat
words.ja: 勝負ものの絵柄。あごと鼻を長くとがらせた顔。黒目は小さく白目を広く。顔の下半分と首に濃い黒ベタの影、光は額と頬だけ。冷や汗のしずくを1〜2個
words.tags: gambling seinen, long pointed chin and nose, small pupils, lower-face black shadow, cold sweat

summary.en: Food and the people who savour it.
summary.ja: 料理とそれを味わう人の絵柄。

words.en: gourmet seinen style: soft, few lines; a rounder, calm face with small, plain eyes; clothes in light tone instead of black; a bright picture with much white paper
words.ja: グルメ漫画の絵柄。やわらかく少ない線で、丸みのあるおだやかな顔、目は小さく素朴。服は黒でなく淡いトーン。白を多く残した明るい画面
words.tags: gourmet seinen, soft few lines, round calm face, small plain eyes, light tone clothes, bright page

summary.en: Accurate depictions of real jobs.
summary.ja: 仕事の現場を正確に描く絵柄。

words.en: professional-drama seinen style: realistic, careful lines of even weight; a neat face with a firm jaw; clothes in two steps of hard-edged flat grey tone instead of solid black; the whole picture brighter
words.ja: 職業ものの絵柄。写実的でていねいな、太さのそろった線。整った顔に引き締まったあご。服は黒ベタでなく、ふちのはっきりした平らな灰色のトーン2段。画面全体を明るく
words.tags: professional drama seinen, realistic even lines, firm jaw, two-step flat grey tone, bright page

summary.en: Quiet, ordinary days.
summary.ja: 何気ない毎日を静かに描く絵柄。

words.en: everyday-life seinen style: thin, soft lines; a gentler, rounder face with slightly larger eyes and two white highlights; clothes in light tone instead of black, a light picture with much white
words.ja: 日常ものの絵柄。細くやわらかい線。顔は丸みのあるやさしい形で、目は少し大きく白い光を2つ。服は黒でなく淡いトーン、白の多い軽い画面
words.tags: everyday life seinen, thin soft lines, gentle round face, larger eyes, light tone clothes, much white

summary.en: Psychological suspense that never lets up.
summary.ja: 緊張と恐怖が続く心理サスペンスの絵柄。

words.en: suspense seinen style: no highlights in the eyes, one side of the face sunk in black shadow; narrow eyes, thin, cold lines; a long black shadow stretching from the figure
words.ja: サスペンスの絵柄。瞳の白い光をなくし、顔の片側を黒い影に沈める。目は細く、線は細く冷たい。足もとから長く伸びる黒い影
words.tags: suspense seinen, eyes without highlights, half-face black shadow, thin cold lines, long black shadow

summary.en: Shaky freehand lines and a city bent like a fisheye lens.
summary.ja: ふるえる手描きの線で、魚眼のように歪む街を描く絵柄。

words.en: warped hand-drawn city style: shaky freehand lines drawn without a ruler; buildings leaning and bending as if seen through a fisheye lens, signboards and wires packed in by hand; figures with round heads, thick lips, a low wide nose and tiny dot-like eyes; the only tone a flat grey sky
words.ja: 手描きで歪む街の絵柄。定規を使わない、ふるえる手描きの線。建物は魚眼レンズのように傾いて曲がり、看板と電線を手描きでびっしり。人物は丸い頭、厚い唇、低く広い鼻、点のように小さな目。トーンは空の灰色だけ
words.tags: shaky freehand lines, fisheye warped buildings, dense hand-drawn wires, round head, thick lips, dot eyes

summary.en: Simple cartoon figures set in finely pen-drawn scenery.
summary.ja: 簡単な顔の人物を、ペンで描き込んだ風景に置く絵柄。

title.ja: 簡単な顔とペンの風景

words.en: simple faces in pen-drawn scenery: figures drawn simply like old cartoons, a round head, dot eyes and a short line for the mouth; houses, trees, grass and streets drawn in fine detail, one by one, with thin pen lines and dots; no screentone, every grey built from lines and dots
words.ja: 簡単な顔と描き込んだ風景の絵柄。人物は昔の漫画のように簡単: 丸い頭、点の目、短い線の口。家・木・草・道は細いペンの線と点で一つずつ細かく描き込む。スクリーントーンは使わず、灰色も線と点で作る
words.tags: simple cartoon figures, dot eyes, detailed pen-drawn scenery, fine lines and dots, no screentone

summary.en: Ordinary people, not good-looking, drawn as in a photograph.
summary.ja: 美形にせず、普通の人の顔と体を写真のように描く絵柄。

title.ja: 美化しない普通の人の写実

words.en: unflattering realist style: people drawn not as good-looking characters but as ordinary people, as in a photograph: small eyes behind thick glasses, a puffy round face, rough skin, stubble, a heavy body; thin lines, shading in layered fine halftone; the background also drawn in photographic detail
words.ja: 美化しない写実の絵柄。人物を美形にせず、写真のような普通の人に描く: 厚い眼鏡の奥の小さな目、むくんだ丸い顔、荒れた肌、無精ひげ、太った体。線は細く、陰影は細かい網点を重ねる。背景も写真のように細かく描く
words.tags: unflattering realism, ordinary people, thick glasses, puffy face, stubble, heavy body, photographic detail

summary.en: Stiff, plain figures set in finely drawn surroundings.
summary.ja: わざと上手く見せない硬い人物を、細かく描き込んだ背景に置く絵柄。

title.ja: 拙い人物と描き込んだ背景

words.en: clumsy figures in detailed surroundings: only the people drawn crudely, like an amateur's drawing: a boxy square head, tiny black dot eyes of different sizes, short lines for the nose and mouth, stiff stick-like arms, hands as round lumps; stiff lines of even weight; the background drawn in detail, object by object, with a little screentone
words.ja: 拙い人物と描き込んだ背景の絵柄。人物だけ素人の絵のように拙く描く: 頭は角ばった四角、目は大きさの違う小さな黒い点、鼻と口は短い線、腕は硬い棒、手は丸い塊。線は太さのそろった硬い線。背景は物を一つずつ細かく描き込み、トーンは少し
words.tags: crude amateur-like figures, boxy head, uneven dot eyes, stick arms, lump hands, stiff lines, detailed background

summary.en: Clean depictions of grown-up women's lives and feelings.
summary.ja: 大人の女性の暮らしと感情を、すっきり描く絵柄。

words.en: josei manga art: clean, refined drawing of grown-up life; very thin, light lines like a fashion illustration; a long neck and neat, grown-up features; almond-shaped eyes close to realistic size with a few long, fine upper lashes and small restrained highlights; a small, neat nose and lips; hair as a glossy solid black mass with a few thin white streaks; slender, 7 to 8 heads tall; almost no screentone, most of the picture left white; the background only a few thin, light lines; a character with true-to-life adult feelings
words.ja: 女性漫画の絵。大人の暮らしを描く、すっきりと洗練された絵。ファッション画のような、ごく細く軽い線。首は長く、顔立ちは端正で大人びている。目は現実に近い大きさの切れ長で、上まつげを細く長く数本、白い光は小さく控えめ。鼻と唇は小さく整った線。髪はつやのある黒ベタのかたまりに細い白い筋を数本。すらりとした7〜8頭身。トーンはほとんど使わず、画面の大半を白く残す。背景は細い線を数本だけで軽く描く。等身大の大人の感情をもつ人物
words.tags: josei manga, very thin light lines, realistic almond eyes, mostly white

summary.en: Quiet, grown-up love.
summary.ja: しっとりした大人の恋の絵柄。

words.en: grown-up romance josei style: a night picture: the background solid black with small round white lights; glossy solid black hair with a white shine band; heavy-lidded, sensual eyes with long lashes; a highlight on the lips
words.ja: 大人の恋愛の絵柄。夜の画面: 背景は黒ベタに白く抜いた小さな丸い光。髪はつやのある黒ベタに白いつやの帯。まぶたの重い色気のある目、長いまつげ、唇に光
words.tags: grown-up romance josei, black night background, glossy black hair, heavy-lidded eyes, long lashes, glossy lips

summary.en: Days of working women.
summary.ja: 働く女性の日々を描く絵柄。

words.en: office josei style: a crisp, cool look: the hair as one sleek solid black shape with a sharp white shine; long, narrow eyes with small irises; a pointed chin; straight, hard lines; shading in two steps of hard-edged flat grey tone
words.ja: お仕事ものの絵柄。きりっと冷たい印象: 髪は黒ベタのなめらかな一つの形に、鋭い白いつや。目は切れ長で黒目は小さい。あごはとがる。まっすぐな硬い線。陰はふちのはっきりした平らな灰色のトーン2段
words.tags: office josei, crisp cool face, pointed chin, long narrow eyes, sleek black hair, hard-edged tones

summary.en: Life at home with family.
summary.ja: 家族との暮らしを描く絵柄。

words.en: family josei style: slightly thicker, rounded, warm lines; a rounder face with full cheeks; big round eyes with two white highlights; the hair as a simple shape with few strand lines; sunlight as a white band
words.ja: 家族・育児の絵柄。少し太く丸い、あたたかい線。顔は頬のふっくらした丸い形、目は大きな丸で白い光を2つ。髪は毛の線の少ない簡単な形。日差しの白い帯
words.tags: family josei, warm rounded lines, round face, full cheeks, big round eyes, sunlight band

summary.en: Sweet, heart-fluttering love.
summary.ja: ときめく恋を甘く描く絵柄。

words.en: love-romance josei style: a younger, softer face with a smaller chin; large, shining eyes with three white highlights and long, curled lashes; lighter hair with white shine bands; a few white sparkles
words.ja: ラブロマンスの絵柄。若くやわらかい顔: あごを小さく、目は大きく輝き白い光を3つ、上向きの長いまつげ。髪は白いつやの帯を入れた軽い形。白いきらめきを数個
words.tags: love romance josei, younger soft face, shining eyes, curled lashes, light hair, white sparkles

summary.en: Delicate relationships between women.
summary.ja: 女性同士の繊細な関係を描く絵柄。

words.en: yuri josei style like lyrical illustration: a small, delicate face with a narrow chin on a long, thin neck; long, narrow, downcast eyes; very thin lines; the hair in soft grey tone instead of black; a few petals drawn as outlines only
words.ja: 百合の絵柄。抒情画のように、小さく繊細な顔に細いあご、細く長い首。目は切れ長で伏し目がち。線はごく細い。髪は黒でなくやわらかな灰色のトーン。線だけの花びらを数枚
words.tags: yuri josei, lyrical illustration look, delicate small face, long thin neck, downcast eyes, grey tone hair

summary.en: Quiet stories of life's turns.
summary.ja: 人生の揺れを静かに描く絵柄。

words.en: human-drama josei style: far fewer lines; the face drawn with only small eyes, a short nose line and a small mouth; the hair as a single flat grey tone shape; wide empty white areas in the picture
words.ja: ヒューマンドラマの絵柄。線をぐっと少なくし、顔は小さな目・短い鼻の線・小さな口だけ。髪は平らな灰色のトーンの面ひとつ。画面に広い白の余白
words.tags: human drama josei, very few lines, minimal face, flat grey hair, wide white space

summary.en: Love in kimono or vintage dress.
summary.ja: 着物や昔の洋装で描く時代ものの恋の絵柄。

words.en: period-romance josei style drawn entirely with an ink brush: outlines that swell and thin like calligraphy, ending in sharp tapered tips; a long oval face with long, narrow eyes and small lips; a traditional wave or hemp-leaf pattern screentone filling the background
words.ja: 時代ロマンの絵柄。すべてを筆で描く: 輪郭は書道のように太く細く変わり、先は鋭く抜ける。面長のうりざね顔に切れ長の目と小さな唇。背景いっぱいに波か麻の葉の和柄の柄トーン
words.tags: period romance josei, calligraphic brush outlines, long oval face, narrow eyes, traditional pattern tone

summary.en: Home cooking and a careful life.
summary.ja: 料理と丁寧な暮らしの絵柄。

words.en: cooking and lifestyle josei style drawn with a felt-tip pen: every line slightly thick and slightly wobbly with rounded ends; a round face with small dot-like eyes and round blush marks; the hair as a rounded outline filled with light tone; almost no other tone
words.ja: 料理・暮らしの絵柄。サインペンの手描きの線: どの線も少し太く、少し揺れ、端は丸い。丸い顔に点のような小さな目と丸い頬の赤み。髪は丸い輪郭に淡いトーン。ほかのトーンはほとんどない
words.tags: cooking and lifestyle josei, felt-tip pen lines, round gentle face, dot-like eyes, light tone hair, little tone

summary.en: Grown-up everyday life full of laughs.
summary.ja: 笑いの多い大人の日常の絵柄。

words.en: comedy josei style: slightly thicker, bouncy lines; a rounder, younger face with a bigger head, about 5 heads tall; big round eyes with one white highlight; the hair as a simple shape; short blush strokes; one sweat-drop symbol
words.ja: コメディの絵柄。少し太く弾む線。顔は丸く若くし、頭を大きめの5頭身。目は大きな丸で白い光を1つ。髪は簡単な形。頬に短い斜線、汗の漫符を1つ
words.tags: comedy josei, bouncy thick lines, round young face, big round eyes, blush strokes, sweat symbol

summary.en: Fear hidden in everyday life.
summary.ja: 日常に潜む怖さを描く大人のサスペンスの絵柄。

words.en: suspense josei style: the picture covered in dark flat tone, half of the face in black shadow; narrower eyes with only one small highlight; a cold black shadow behind the figure
words.ja: サスペンスの絵柄。画面を暗い平らなトーンで覆い、顔の半分を黒い影に。目の光は小さく1つ、目は細め。人物の後ろに冷たい黒い影
words.tags: suspense josei, dark flat tone, half-face shadow, narrow eyes, cold black shadow

summary.en: Extremely long faces, long legs and fine-line hair; aesthetic.
summary.ja: 極端に細長い顔と長い脚、細い線の髪の耽美な絵柄。

words.en: 1990s tanbi aesthetic style: an extremely long, narrow face with a sharply pointed chin; a long thin nose; long narrow eyes with small dark irises; hair drawn as hundreds of fine flowing lines, long bangs falling over one eye; broad shoulders and very long legs, 9 to 10 heads tall
words.ja: 90年代の耽美な絵柄。顔は極端に細長く、あごは鋭くとがる。鼻筋は長く細い。目は切れ長で黒目は小さい。髪は細い線を何百本も流し、長い前髪が片目にかかる。肩幅が広く脚の長い9〜10頭身
words.tags: 1990s tanbi, extremely long narrow face, pointed chin, narrow eyes, fine-line flowing hair, 9 to 10 heads

summary.en: Bright, cheerful styles kids read at a glance.
summary.ja: 子どもがひと目でわかる、明るく元気な絵柄。

words.en: children's manga art for elementary school readers, drawn to be understood at a glance: thick, firm, rounded outlines; a round face where the big round eyes stand out most, with large solid-black pupils and one big white highlight; the nose a tiny dot or left out; a small mouth drawn as a shape that shows the expression; about 3 to 4 heads tall with a big head; hair as one big solid black mass with no strand lines; very little screentone, mostly white areas with a few solid blacks; the background a few simple shapes; a bright, cheerful character
words.ja: 児童漫画の絵。小学生がひと目でわかる、わかりやすさ第一の絵。太めのしっかりした丸みのある線。丸い顔で、目は顔の中でいちばん大きく丸く、黒目を大きく塗り、白い光を大きく1つ。鼻は小さな点か描かない。口は小さく、表情がわかる形で描く。頭の大きい3〜4頭身。髪は黒ベタの大きなかたまりで、毛の線は描かない。トーンは少なく白い面を多く、ベタは少し。背景は簡単な形を数個だけ。明るく元気な人物
words.tags: children's manga, thick rounded lines, big round eyes, short proportions

summary.en: Heated matches with toys and games.
summary.ja: おもちゃやゲームで熱く対戦する絵柄。

words.en: hobby-battle style for children: very thick lines; big eyes with sharply upturned outer corners, small intense pupils and one highlight; spiky hair points; focus lines in the background
words.ja: ホビー漫画の絵柄。とても太い線。目は大きく目じりが鋭くつり上がり、黒目は小さく熱い光を1つ。髪はとがった房。背景に集中線
words.tags: hobby battle for children, very thick lines, sharply upturned eyes, spiky hair, focus lines

summary.en: Exploring forests and caves.
summary.ja: 森や洞窟を探検する冒険の絵柄。

words.en: adventure style for children: very thick, brush-like outlines; sharp eyes with small pupils under thick, slanted brows; strong sunlight casting large solid black shadows on one side of the face and body; the sky pure white
words.ja: 冒険の絵柄。筆で描いたようなとても太い輪郭。目は黒目が小さく、太くつり上がった眉の下でするどい。強い日差しで、顔と体の片側に大きな黒い影。空は真っ白
words.tags: adventure for children, thick brush-like outlines, sharp eyes, thick slanted brows, strong sun shadows, white sky

summary.en: Slapstick that makes kids laugh.
summary.ja: 子どもが笑うドタバタの絵柄。

words.en: gag style for children: deformed down to 2 to 3 heads tall; eyes as white circles with dot pupils; a big, simple mouth shape; one or two manga symbols such as dizzy stars or sweat drops
words.ja: ギャグの絵柄。2〜3頭身まで崩し、目は白い丸に点の黒目。口は大きく単純な形。星や汗の漫符を1〜2個
words.tags: gag for children, 2 to 3 heads tall, circle eyes with dot pupils, big simple mouth, manga symbols

summary.en: Animals as the main characters.
summary.ja: 動物たちが主人公の絵柄。

words.en: picture-book animal-story style for children: soft, rounded lines of gentle weight; a plump face with small black oval eyes; no solid black anywhere, the hair included, only soft light halftone
words.ja: 絵本のような動物ものの絵柄。やわらかく丸い、やさしい太さの線。顔はふっくら、目は小さな黒い楕円。髪も含めて黒ベタを使わず、やわらかな淡いトーン
words.tags: picture-book animal story, soft round lines, plump face, small oval eyes, no solid black, light tone

summary.en: Clear pictures that explain how things work.
summary.ja: しくみや歴史をわかりやすく見せる絵柄。

words.en: educational-comic style for children: a neater, calmer picture with a smaller head, about 5 heads tall; smaller eyes with near-dot pupils and a small highlight; clean, even lines; background objects drawn with accurate shapes
words.ja: 学習まんがの絵柄。落ち着いた整った絵: 頭を小さめの5頭身。目は小さめで黒目は点に近く、小さな光。線はきれいで均一。背景の物は形を正確に描く
words.tags: educational comic, neat calm drawing, 5 heads tall, small eyes, clean even lines, accurate objects

summary.en: Cute magical transformations.
summary.ja: かわいく変身する魔法ものの絵柄。

words.en: magic-transformation style for children: big sparkling eyes with star-shaped white highlights and a few lashes; a softer face, a white shine band on the hair; a few white stars cut out of the tone and a few radiating lines
words.ja: 魔法・変身の絵柄。目は大きくきらきらし、瞳に星形の白い光とまつげ数本。顔はやわらかく、髪に白いつやの帯。トーンを白く抜いた星を数個と、放射状の線を数本
words.tags: magic transformation for children, sparkling eyes, star highlights, soft face, white stars, radiating lines

summary.en: Everyday life at school.
summary.ja: 学校の毎日を描く絵柄。

words.en: school-life style for children: the hair drawn only as an outline with no black fill; thin, gentle lines of even weight; a smaller head on a slimmer figure about 5 heads tall; smaller eyes with small pupils
words.ja: 学校生活の絵柄。髪は黒く塗らず、輪郭だけで描く。細くやさしい、太さのそろった線。頭を小さめにした、細身の5頭身。目は小さめで黒目も小さい
words.tags: school life for children, outline-only hair, thin gentle lines, slim 5 heads tall, small eyes

summary.en: Sports full of energy.
summary.ja: 元気いっぱいのスポーツの絵柄。

words.en: sports style for children: half of the background covered by horizontal speed lines; the body in vigorous lines; determined eyes with upturned outer corners under thick brows; one or two sweat drops
words.ja: スポーツの絵柄。背景の半分を横に流れるスピード線で覆う。体は勢いのある線、目は目じりの上がった真剣な形で眉は太い。汗のしずくを1〜2個
words.tags: sports for children, speed lines, vigorous lines, determined eyes, thick brows, sweat drops

summary.en: Playing detective and solving puzzles.
summary.ja: 探偵ごっこや謎解きの絵柄。

words.en: mystery style for children: the picture covered in darker flat screentone, white left only on the lit side of the face; keen, slightly narrowed eyes
words.ja: なぞときの絵柄。画面を暗めの平らなトーンで覆い、顔の光の側だけ白く残す。目はきりっと細め
words.tags: mystery for children, dark flat tone, lit half face, keen narrowed eyes

summary.en: Slightly scary, cute ghosts.
summary.ja: ちょっと怖くてかわいいおばけの絵柄。

words.en: spooky-monster style for children: the figure standing out white against a solid black night; thick, round lines; eyes as big white circles with no pupils
words.ja: おばけ・モンスターの絵柄。夜の黒ベタの中に人物を白く浮かせる。線は太く丸く、目は黒目のない大きな白い丸
words.tags: spooky monster for children, black night, white figure, thick round lines, pupil-less white eyes

summary.en: Figures built from circles and squares; stylish.
summary.ja: 丸や四角の図形で人物を組み立てる、洒落た絵柄。

words.en: mid-century modern geometric style for children: figures assembled from simple shapes, a big circle for the head, a triangle or rectangle for the body, thin sticks for arms and legs; the face only dot eyes and a short line mouth; hard, even, ruler-like lines; areas filled flat in white, flat grey tone or black, with no shading
words.ja: 図形で組み立てるモダンな絵柄。人物は単純な図形を組んで作る: 頭は大きな円、胴は三角か四角、手足は細い棒。顔は点の目と短い線の口だけ。線は定規で引いたように硬く均一。面は白・平らなトーン・黒で塗り分け、陰影は付けない
words.tags: mid-century modern, geometric shapes, circle head, stick limbs, dot eyes, flat fills, no shading

summary.en: Simple, friendly styles readable even in small panels.
summary.ja: 小さなコマでも読める、簡潔で親しみやすい絵柄。

words.en: simple compact character art that reads clearly even at a small size: thin, even, clean lines; about 4 to 5 heads tall; fairly large eyes with inked pupils and two white highlights; almost no nose, a small simple mouth; hair as a simple solid black mass with no strand lines; almost no screentone, mostly white; the background plain white with only one or two shapes of the place; a friendly, easygoing character
words.ja: 小さく描いてもはっきり読める、簡潔な人物の絵。細く均一なすっきりした線。4〜5頭身。目は大きめで黒目を塗り、白い光を2つ。鼻はほとんど描かず、口は小さな簡単な線。髪は黒ベタの簡単なかたまりで、毛の線は描かない。トーンはほとんど使わず白を多く。背景は白地に場所の形を1〜2個だけ。ほのぼのした親しみやすい人物
words.tags: compact characters, readable at small size, clean thin lines, mostly white

summary.en: Heart-warming family days.
summary.ja: 家族のほのぼのした毎日の絵柄。

words.en: old-fashioned family-comic style: very simple, thick lines of even weight; a round face with eyes as two small black dots with no highlights and a tiny nose; the hair as one simple black shape without strand lines; almost no tone
words.ja: 昔ながらの家庭ものの絵柄。とても簡単な太さのそろった太い線。丸い顔に、目は光のない小さな黒い点2つ、鼻は小さく。髪は毛の線のない黒い形ひとつ。トーンはほとんど使わない
words.tags: old-fashioned family comic, simple thick lines, round face, dot eyes, simple black hair, almost no tone

summary.en: Easygoing classroom exchanges.
summary.ja: 教室のゆるいやりとりの絵柄。

words.en: moe-leaning style: very large eyes with three highlights; a round, childlike face with a small chin and a big head, about 3 to 4 heads tall; a white shine band across the hair
words.ja: 萌え寄りの絵柄。目をとても大きくして光を3つ、あごの小さな丸く幼い顔、頭を大きく3〜4頭身。髪につやの白い帯
words.tags: moe-leaning, very large eyes, round childlike face, 3 to 4 heads tall, hair shine band

summary.en: Relatable moments at work.
summary.ja: 職場のあるあるを描く絵柄。

words.en: grown-up office-comic style: an adult face, longer, with a defined chin; smaller eyes with one small highlight and a small nose line; about 6 heads tall; clean, simple lines
words.ja: 大人の職場ものの絵柄。面長であごのはっきりした大人の顔、目は小さめで白い光は小さく1つ、鼻の線を小さく。約6頭身。線はすっきり簡単
words.tags: grown-up office comic, adult longer face, small eyes, 6 heads tall, clean simple lines

summary.en: Cute characters and relaxed days.
summary.ja: かわいい人物のゆるい日常の絵柄。

words.en: laid-back slice-of-life style: deformed down to a round 2 to 3 heads tall with short, round limbs; eyes as big black ovals; round, soft lines
words.ja: ゆるい日常ものの絵柄。2〜3頭身まで丸く崩し、手足を短く丸く。目は大きな黒い楕円。線は丸くやわらかい
words.tags: laid-back slice of life, 2 to 3 heads tall, short round limbs, big black oval eyes, soft round lines

summary.en: Everyday life with dogs and cats.
summary.ja: 犬や猫の日常の絵柄。

words.en: pet-comic style: rounder, softer lines with much white left; small black oval eyes with one highlight and plump cheeks; the hair in light tone instead of black
words.ja: ペットものの絵柄。線を丸くやわらかくし、白い面を多く残す。目は光を1つ入れた小さな黒い楕円、頬はふっくら。髪は黒でなく淡いトーン
words.tags: pet comic, soft round lines, small oval eyes, plump cheeks, light tone hair, much white

summary.en: Concise drawings like a daily paper strip.

words.ja: 闘病エッセイの絵柄。トーンを使わず、白の多い静かな画面。線はごく少なく細い
words.tags: health essay, no screentone, quiet white page, very few thin lines

summary.en: Life with pets.
summary.ja: ペットとの暮らしの絵柄。

words.en: pet essay style: fluffy outlines made of short broken strokes like fur; the hair a soft, fluffy shape in light tone instead of solid black; eyes as tiny dots with round blush marks; everything rounded and soft
words.ja: ペットエッセイの絵柄。毛並みのような短い途切れ線でふわふわに描く。髪は黒ベタをやめ、淡いトーンのふわっとした形。目は小さな点、頬に丸い赤み。すべてを丸くやわらかく
words.tags: pet essay, fluffy broken outlines, soft light tone hair, tiny dot eyes, round blush

summary.en: Absorbed in what you love.
summary.ja: 好きなことに夢中な絵柄。

words.en: hobby essay style: thick, even marker-pen lines with rounded ends; no screentone, black only as the flat black of the hair; eyes as small dots; only everyday objects drawn with precise, careful shapes
words.ja: 趣味エッセイの絵柄。太さのそろった太いマーカーの線で、線の端は丸い。トーンは使わず、黒は髪の平らな黒だけ。目は小さな点。身の回りの物だけ、形を正確にていねいに描く
words.tags: hobby essay, thick marker lines, no screentone, flat black hair, dot eyes, precise objects

summary.en: Reporting from the scene.
summary.ja: 現場を取材して伝える絵柄。

words.en: reportage essay style: the figure deliberately simple: a plain round face with eyes as short horizontal dashes and no nose; the background drawn realistically as if from a photo, with ruled lines and flat grey tone
words.ja: ルポの絵柄。人物はわざと簡単に: 丸い顔に、目は短い横線、鼻はない。背景は写真を元にしたように写実的に、定規の線と平らな灰色のトーンで描く
words.tags: reportage essay, simple figure, dash eyes, no nose, realistic ruled background, flat grey tone

summary.en: Life together and love.
summary.ja: 二人の暮らしや恋を描く絵柄。

words.en: romance essay style: slightly bigger, round eyes with one highlight; a few blush strokes on the cheeks; soft lines
words.ja: 恋愛エッセイの絵柄。目を少し大きく丸くして光を1つ、頬に赤面の斜線を数本。線はやわらかい
words.tags: romance essay, bigger round eyes, one highlight, blush strokes, soft lines

summary.en: Rugged, realistic drama with heavy shadows for adults.
summary.ja: 骨太で写実的、重い陰影の大人の劇画の絵柄。

words.en: gekiga art: heavy, cinematic, realistic drawing; sharp dip-pen lines with strong thick-to-thin variation, few in number but forceful; a realistic face with firm bone structure, narrow sharp eyes with small pupils, dark eyebrows; light and shadow split cleanly: large solid black shadows on half of the face and on the body, the lit side left white, and only a few short hatch strokes where light meets shadow; hair as solid black with sharp-edged locks; about 8 heads tall; the background weighed down with large solid black areas and few lines; a character with a weighty, formidable presence
words.ja: 劇画の絵。映画のように重く写実的な絵。強弱の大きい鋭いペン線を、少ない本数で力強く引く。骨格のはっきりした写実的な顔で、目は細く鋭く、黒目は小さい。眉は濃い。光と影をすっきり分け、顔の半分と体の影を大きな黒ベタで塗り、光の側は白く残す。斜線は影の境目に短く数本だけ。髪は黒ベタに鋭い房。8頭身の現実的な体つき。背景は大きな黒ベタの面で重くし、線は少ない。重みと凄みのある人物
words.tags: gekiga, realistic, heavy solid blacks, clean light-and-shadow split, few bold lines

summary.en: Swordsmen radiating killing intent.
summary.ja: 殺気ただよう剣豪ものの絵柄。

words.en: samurai period gekiga style: every outline a few thick brush strokes that swell and taper; the hair as rough brush masses; solid black shadows laid first to carve out the forms; a few dry-brush streaks
words.ja: 時代劇の絵柄。輪郭はすべて、太く入って細く抜ける筆の線を少ない本数で。髪は荒い筆の塊。影の黒を先に塗って形を切り出す。かすれた筆の跡を数本
words.tags: samurai gekiga, thick tapering brush strokes, rough brush hair, carved black shadows, dry brush

summary.en: Duty and loyalty in the underworld.
summary.ja: 義理と人情の任侠ものの絵柄。

words.en: yakuza gekiga style: thick, heavy brush-pen outlines with strong swelling and tapering; a broader, heavier face with a jutting brow; the eyes as narrow slits with tiny pupils; no grey tone at all, only a harsh contrast of solid black and white
words.ja: 任侠の絵柄。筆ペンの太く重い、強弱の大きい輪郭。眉の骨が張った、幅の広い重い顔。目は細い切れ目で、白目の中に小さな黒目。灰色のトーンは使わず、黒ベタと白だけのきつい対比
words.tags: yakuza gekiga, heavy brush-pen outlines, broad heavy face, slit eyes, harsh black and white

summary.en: Detectives against criminals.
summary.ja: 刑事と犯罪者の攻防の絵柄。

words.en: police-crime gekiga style: a cleaner, modern look with thin pen lines of even weight; a leaner face with fewer wrinkles; shadows as hard-edged flat mid-grey tone instead of solid black; the lit side of the face plain white
words.ja: 刑事ものの絵柄。現代的でさっぱりした、太さのそろった細いペンの線。顔はしわを減らしてすっきり。影は黒ベタでなく、ふちのはっきりした中くらいの灰色の平らなトーン。顔の光の側は白
words.tags: police gekiga, clean thin pen lines, lean face, hard-edged mid-grey tone, white lit side

summary.en: The harshness of the battlefield.
summary.ja: 戦場の過酷さを描く絵柄。

words.en: war gekiga style: the whole picture sunk in flat grey tone with little white; a tired face with hollow cheeks
words.ja: 戦記の絵柄。全体を灰色の平らなトーンで沈め、白を少なくする。顔は疲れて頬がこける
words.tags: war gekiga, flat grey tone, little white, tired face, hollow cheeks

summary.en: A cold world of silent characters.
summary.ja: 無口な人物の非情な世界の絵柄。

words.en: hard-boiled gekiga style: the background as pale fog: mostly light grey tone and white with only faint distant shapes; only the figure in hard black and white; dry, hard, thin lines; sharp cheekbones
words.ja: ハードボイルドの絵柄。背景は淡い霧: 大半を淡い灰色のトーンと白にし、遠くの物はかすかな形だけ。人物だけを強い黒と白で描く。乾いた硬い細い線、鋭い頬骨
words.tags: hard-boiled gekiga, pale fog background, hard black and white figure, dry thin lines, sharp cheekbones

summary.en: The realities of society.
summary.ja: 社会の現実を描く絵柄。

words.en: social-drama gekiga style: no strong contrast, a tired, quiet picture built mainly from flat grey tone; thin lines
words.ja: 社会派の絵柄。強い明暗をやめ、平らな灰色のトーンを中心にした疲れた静かな画面。線は細い
words.tags: social drama gekiga, low contrast, flat grey tone, tired quiet face, thin lines

summary.en: Sweat and scars of fighting sports.
summary.ja: 汗と傷の格闘技・スポーツの絵柄。

words.en: sports gekiga style: large white sweat glints on the face and neck with flying drops of sweat; tense jaw and neck muscles; bold, fast strokes; radiating focus lines over the background
words.ja: スポーツ劇画の絵柄。顔と首に大きな白い汗の光と飛び散る汗のしずく。あごと首の筋肉を張らせる。勢いのある太く速い筆致。背景に放射状の集中線
words.tags: sports gekiga, sweat glints, flying sweat, tense jaw and neck, bold fast strokes, focus lines

summary.en: Realistic, visceral tales of the strange.
summary.ja: 写実的で生々しい怪奇ものの絵柄。

words.en: kaiki horror gekiga style like old horror comics: wide whites with small pupils; eerie shadows on the face
words.ja: 怪奇劇画の絵柄。昔の怪奇漫画のように、白目を広く黒目を小さく描き、顔に不気味な影

summary.en: Battles and ensembles of history.
summary.ja: 合戦と群像の歴史劇の絵柄。

words.en: historical-epic gekiga style: a calm, classical drawing: quiet lines of even weight, a dignified face with a straight nose; solid black only on the hair, the figure and the background in light and middle flat grey tones; much lighter overall

words.tags: historical epic gekiga, calm even lines, dignified face, black only on hair, light flat tones

summary.en: Racing through jungles and deserts.
summary.ja: 密林や砂漠を駆ける冒険の絵柄。

words.en: adventure gekiga style: the scene lit by bright midday sun: most of the picture left as white paper, with short, sharp black shadows only under the brow, nose and chin; large, vigorous lines
words.ja: 冒険活劇の絵柄。真昼の強い日差しの画面にする: 画面の大半を白い紙に残し、眉の下・鼻・あご下だけに短く鋭い黒い影。勢いのある大きな線
words.tags: adventure gekiga, bright midday sun, mostly white page, short sharp shadows, large vigorous lines

summary.en: Muscles and wrinkles cut into the face with lines; frenzied.
summary.ja: 顔の筋やしわを線で刻み込む、狂気の劇画の絵柄。

title.ja: 皮膚を刻む凄惨な劇画

words.en: grotesque carved-skin gekiga style: the whole skin of the face carved with thin groove-like lines, each muscle, wrinkle and vein cut in one by one; eyes stretched wide open, a tiny black pupil in the middle of the white; teeth clenched, showing the teeth and gums; shading in flat grey tone
words.ja: 皮膚を刻む凄惨な劇画の絵柄。顔の皮膚一面に、筋・しわ・血管を細い溝のような線で一本ずつ刻む。目は大きく見開き、白目の真ん中に小さな黒目。歯を食いしばり、歯と歯ぐきを見せる。陰影は平らな灰色のトーン
words.tags: carved skin lines, muscles and veins on the face, wide staring eyes, tiny pupils, bared teeth and gums

summary.en: Heavyset bearded men drawn in clean, even lines.
summary.ja: ひげの中年男の太い体を、くっきりした線で描く絵柄。

title.ja: ひげと太い体の男たち

words.en: heavyset bearded men style: men drawn with a thick neck, a broad chest and a round belly, a solid heavy build; the beard thick, as a mass of solid black; thick eyebrows and a square jaw; clean, confident lines of even weight; a white page with flat grey tone
words.ja: ひげと太い体の男の絵柄。男は太い首・厚い胸・出た腹の、がっしりした太い体に描く。ひげは濃く、黒ベタの塊で。太い眉に角ばったあご。線は太さのそろったくっきりした線。白い画面に平らな灰色のトーン
words.tags: heavyset men, thick neck, broad chest, belly, thick black beard, square jaw, clean even lines, grey tone
